“We Buy Pokémon Cards” ad templates

WeBuy.AD makes buyback ads for card shops and collectors who buy Pokémon collections, sealed product and graded cards. Pick a design, type your phone number and area, and download an image ready for Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, Instagram or a printed flyer.

See the Pokémon cards designs Pricing

How it works

  1. Pick a design. Open the Pokémon cards designs and click one. It opens in the studio with its colours, product picture and copy already in place.
  2. Type your details. Your phone number, website if you have one, and your ZIP or city. Save them once in your brand kit and every design fills them in.
  3. Download and post. Choose a size (square for feeds, 9:16 for stories, 8.5×11 for print) and download. The top 3 Pokémon Cards designs are on the free plan; every paid plan unlocks the rest.

What to put on a Pokémon card buyback ad

  • What you take: bulk collections, holos, sealed booster boxes, graded slabs.
  • Whether you buy whole binders or single cards.
  • How you pay and where you meet.
  • Your phone number and your area.

Keep it to one headline, a few short selling points and one number. People scroll past an ad in a second; the ones that get texts are readable at a glance on a phone.

Questions

Which Pokémon designs are free?

The top 3 designs in the Pokémon Cards category are on the free plan. Every paid plan, from Starter at $25 a month, unlocks every design in every category.

Can I use Pokémon artwork on my ad?

Only use pictures you have the right to use. The studio’s own card pictures are generic product shots; if you upload artwork, the rights are yours to check.

Is it free?

You can design without an account. Downloading needs a free account: 3 photo downloads a week at 1080 pixels with a WeBuy.AD watermark. Starter is $25 a month for 100 photo downloads up to 2160 pixels, no watermark, every design. Pro ($60) adds video ads and 500 downloads a month; Business ($100) is unlimited.
